MIZORAM PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
GENERAL COMPETITIVE EXAMINATIONS FOR RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF U.D.C.
UNDER SOCIAL WELFARE DEPARTMENT
JUNE, 2018
PAPER - I
Time Allowed : 3 hours
Full Marks : 125
Attempt all questions.
SECTION - A
(50 Marks)
This Section should be answered only on the Answer Sheet provided.
1. Write an essay in about 500 words on Traffic problem in Aizawl.
(25)
2. Write a précis on the following passage.
(25)
To carry on their work successfully, all democracies depend on their parliamentary institutions.
This calls for the right of free speech and respect for the rights of minorities. Nobody can exercise the
freedom of expression without a measure of tolerance. Human dignity, individual responsibility and
economic freedom are some of the important characteristics which distinguish democracy from other
forms of government. Human freedom lies at the core of a democratic government. It allows all
citizens various types of freedoms such as those of expression, faith and worship, and organization
and association. Moreover, all are treated alike; they are equal before the law and are entitled to
equal opportunities in various walks of life. But democracy is a difficult form of government : it should
never be taken for granted. It must function in a dynamic way. In other words, people should never
cease to participate, nor should they become indifferent to functioning of democracy. It would be a
dangerous thing to do. Those who can look back to the Great War, will remember how shallow were
the roots of some of the democracies in Europe, and how they were soon replaced by various types
of dictatorships.
Unfortunately, democracy is not always a very efficient form of government. It depends on
debate, discussion, and exchange of opinions. The whole process is tardy and time-consuming. For
this reason, some people become weary of democracy. Moreover, you have to surrender to the will
of the majority even when you think it wrong. Another weakness of the democratic system, paradoxical
though it may seem, is inherent in itself. It grants freedom to all including even those who seek to
injure and destroy it. In such a situation even a true democrat might be forced to compromise. The
practicable might have to be preferred to the idea.
As long as human nature remains what it is, there can be no perfect form of government. Nor
can democracy claim to be such. But of all the forms of political organizations known to man, it has
been found to be best so far. No wonder, even dictators swear by it. We often talk about the failure
of democracy. But more often than not it is the failure of our intelligence. So we should not abandon
democracy. It is not merely a form of political organization, it is indeed a way of life. It is an ideal
worth to be pursued and preserved.
